title: Asked yes or no, it says yes
notes: yes|no compiles to a DFA of 5 states. From q0 the index allows yes, ye, y, no and n; yeah, the model's favourite, falls off at its a and is masked. Softmax over the five left gives yes 0.45, so greedy writes yes, and from q3 only </s> is allowed. Building the index took 71 lookups.
